name: IIT Madras

about.text: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Madras is one of the top institutes in India. It is the second established institute of the IIT family. It all started with the envision of then Prime Minister, Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru after they visited Germany where he was supported by the Government of the Federal Republic of Germany to establish institutes for high technology studies. Right after the signing of the Indo-German Agreement in 1959. IIT Madras was established and it was inaugurated by Professor Humayun Kabir in 1959. Known for its excellent academic delivery, it is ranked as one of the top engineering institutes in India. It is a world-renowned institute that offers quality information and research-oriented studies.

The institute is innovative and diverse and carries a strong envision of new research ideas. They are actively involved in working in the research field related to robotics, artificial intelligence, nanotechnology, sustainable energy and many more. The professors of the institute are highly qualified and experts in the respective fields With cutting-edge technology, the latest and dynamic research project ideas and published papers in journals and magazines the institute is creating a new envision. The Institute is striving to achieve an entrepreneurship ecosystem by supporting new startups and collaborating with industry newbies.

about.text: The institute has introduced various new certificate courses in online mode through the Center for Outreach & Digital Education, which is designed especially for working professionals who are ready to learn and take their careers to the next higher level. Their online programs are in high demand and give flexibility to working professionals to learn with ease. Also, students belonging to the distinct places away from the main campus find it very helpful.

Courses offered at IIT Madras include Undergraduate courses, postgraduate courses, doctoral programs and many online courses. Some are Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.), and Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) in Various Engineering Disciplines, Master of Technology (M.Tech.) - Specializations in Engineering and Technology Fields, Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Two-year Full-Time MBA Program, Master of Science (M.Sc.) - Programs in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Data Science, Master of Arts (M.A.) - Programs in Humanities and Social Sciences, Master of City Planning (MCP) - Urban Planning and Development, Master of Design (M.Des.) - Programs in Design and Related Fields, Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) - Research-Based Doctoral Programs, and online degree program that is Online B.Sc. Degree in Programming and Data Science.

Many online certificate and diploma courses are provided to the students through SWAYAM, NPTEL and many more. Many departments offer quality education like Aerospace Engineering, Management Studies, Applied Mechanics, Mathematics, Biotechnology, Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Design, Chemistry, Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, Civil Engineering, Ocean Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Medical Science and Technology, Humanities and Social Sciences and many more. The Institute is approved by the All India Council for Technical Education and ranked as the number one engineering college by the National Institutional Ranking Framework. It is also accredited by NAAC grade.

emi.text: Meritorious students are highly encouraged by the institute as it offers various scholarships and financial assistance to the students. The Institute is giving fee waivers to many students, depending on certain eligibility criteria. The Institute is giving scholarships to various students belonging to certain groups like SC, ST & female students. Merit-cum-Means scholarships, Institute Notional Prize, Institute free studentship, Dr K Vasanth Rau Scholarships and many more scholarships are offered to the students.

admission.text: Admission to IIT is not an easy task. You have to go through various stages of selection. However, the admission to each course may vary. Some course requires an entrance examination. Also, before choosing the course check all the eligibility criteria for selection. Here are the basic steps that are advised to be followed by the candidates.

Step 1- If you are applying for B.Tech, you are required to appear and clear JEE while if you are seeking admission to M.Sc, appear for the examination like JAM. It also offers various online degree programs. Students must have basic eligibility criteria fulfilled.
Step 2- As the candidates get selected and clear the cutoff, they can move on to the next step of registering online on the official website.
Step 3- Now, students can check the references and move to applying on the website.
Step 4- Enter all the details and make sure you end up doing all the work with the correct information.
Step 5- Upload all the required documents and scan them before uploading them.
Step 6- The next step is fee payment which is done on the payment portal. Keep a print of the receipt before uploading it.
Step 7- For more information, you can move to the SWAYAM or NPTEL portal.

examination.text: The Examination is done by the institute in online mode. However, this applies only to students enrolled in online degree programs. The institute conducts online examinations through the online platform or LMS. The institute ensures high security and strict monitoring. The institute is also using remote assessment conduction, the students have to complete the examination in a stipulated time frame. Students must have tech devices like computers with good internet connectivity.

faqs.q: Are the courses offered by IIT Madras valid?
faqs.a: Yes, all the courses offered by the IIT Madras are valid and approved. It is ranked as a top engineering college by NIRF.

faqs.q: What are the courses offered to the students at IIT Madras?
faqs.a: IIT Madras offers Undergraduate courses, postgraduate courses, doctoral programs and many online courses.

faqs.q: What disciplines are offered at IIT Madras?
faqs.a: Disciplines offered by Aerospace Engineering, Management Studies, Applied Mechanics, Mathematics, Biotechnology, Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Design, Chemistry, Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, Civil Engineering, Ocean Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Medical Science and Technology, Humanities and Social Sciences and many more.

faqs.q: Will the mode of learning be shown on the IIT Madras marksheet?
faqs.a: No, the mode of learning will not be mentioned on the mark sheet.

faqs.q: Does IIT Madras offer online programs?
faqs.a: Yes, IIT Madras offers an Online B.Sc. Degree in Programming and Data Science program and many other certificate programs in online mode.
